_doc: glaive-hands round 1: N1 contact grip thumbnails (gh_probe.py). Control: the haft 6 deg from horizontal through the pelvis (GR-N05), hands 49 px apart (GR-P01 24-30), the front (far) hand 12.5 cm off the haft (GR-N01). Joints (control): shoulders L (0.146, -0.612, 1.085) R (-0.055, -0.549, 1.135), hips L (0.066, -0.391, 0.787) R (-0.075, -0.401, 0.792). Variants: the rear (near, R) hand at the near hip, the front hand 0.36 m up the haft (27 px), the haft rising (m1-m3) or falling (m4) through the grip.
